fields.label: Training Hero Headline
fields.value: ASSE 6000 Series Certification Training

fields.label: Training Hero Description
fields.value: Professional certification programs for medical gas installers, inspectors, and maintenance technicians

fields.label: Training Intro Paragraph
fields.value: DARPA SOLUTIONS LLC offers nationally recognized ASSE 6000 Series certification training for medical gas professionals across the country. Our courses are taught by field-experienced instructors who bring real-world knowledge into the classroom, combining NFPA code requirements with hands-on application. Whether you are entering the industry for the first time or maintaining your existing certification, our structured curriculum ensures you are fully prepared for the written and practical examinations.

fields.label: Training Lab Title
fields.value: Built around the way medical gas work is actually performed

fields.label: Training Lab Description
fields.value: Courses combine classroom instruction, code discussion, operating trainer demonstrations, and hands-on practice with the equipment students see in the field.

fields.label: 6010 Course Title
fields.value: ASSE 6010 - Medical Gas Installer Course

fields.label: 6010 Course Overview
fields.value: The ASSE 6010 Medical Gas Installer course provides comprehensive instruction on the installation of medical gas piping systems in healthcare facilities. Students will gain an in-depth understanding of NFPA 99 requirements, proper brazing techniques, and the safety protocols required to work on these critical life-safety systems. The course includes both a written examination and a hands-on practical brazing session.

fields.label: 6020 Course Title
fields.value: ASSE 6020 - Medical Gas Inspector Course

fields.label: 6020 Course Overview
fields.value: The ASSE 6020 Medical Gas Inspector course is designed for professionals responsible for the inspection and verification of medical gas piping systems. Students will learn how to evaluate systems for compliance with NFPA 99, produce accurate inspection reports, and classify deficiencies according to applicable codes. This course is entirely classroom-based and concludes with a written examination.

fields.label: 6040 Course Title
fields.value: ASSE 6040 - Medical Gas Maintenance Technician Course

fields.label: 6040 Course Overview
fields.value: The ASSE 6040 Medical Gas Maintenance Technician course trains healthcare facility personnel on the proper maintenance, repair, and troubleshooting of in-place medical gas systems. Students will learn NFPA 99 maintenance requirements, how to plan and execute scheduled shutdowns, perform outlet repairs and replacements, and maintain accurate documentation. The course includes a practical demonstration component in addition to the written examination.
